```{=html}
<style>
.w033 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w033 .w033-scenario {
  padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w033 .w033-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w033 .w033-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w033 .w033-q { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w033 .w033-in {
  flex: 0 0 110px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  font-weight: 600; min-width: 0;
}
.w033 .w033-in.w033-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w033 .w033-in.w033-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w033 .w033-unit { flex: 0 0 auto; opacity: 0.8; }
.w033 .w033-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w033 button.w033-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w033 .w033-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w033 .w033-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w033 .w033-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w033 .w033-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w033 .w033-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w033 iw" id="w033">
  <div class="w033-scenario">
    A service chains three components, and every request needs all three:
    a load balancer at <strong>99.99&nbsp;%</strong>, a web virtual machine at
    <strong>99.9&nbsp;%</strong> and a database virtual machine at
    <strong>99.9&nbsp;%</strong>. Take 1&nbsp;year&nbsp;≈&nbsp;8760&nbsp;h.
  </div>
  <div class="w033-rows">
    <div class="w033-row">
      <label class="w033-q" for="w033-in0">Combined availability (round to two decimals)</label>
      <input class="w033-in" id="w033-in0" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" data-k="0">
      <span class="w033-unit">%</span>
    </div>
    <div class="w033-row">
      <label class="w033-q" for="w033-in1">Expected downtime per year (about)</label>
      <input class="w033-in" id="w033-in1" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" data-k="1">
      <span class="w033-unit">h</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w033-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w033-btn w033-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w033-btn w033-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w033-btn w033-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w033-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w033-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w033-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Every request needs all three components, so the combined availability is the product 0.9999 × 0.999 × 0.999 ≈ 99.79 %, and the missing 0.21 % of 8760 h is about 18.4 h of expected downtime per year - every chained component spends availability, and only deliberate redundancy buys it back. See <a href="#exm-compositesla">the composite-SLA example</a> in <a href="#sec-03-sla">the section on availability as a number</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w033');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w033-msg');
  const inputs = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w033-in')];
  // 0.9999 * 0.999 * 0.999 = 0.9979012... -> 99.79 % ; (1 - 0.9979012) * 8760 h = 18.39 h
  const ANSWERS = [
    { value: 99.79, tol: 0.02, show: '99.79' },
    { value: 18.39, tol: 0.7, show: '18.4' }
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    inputs.forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w033-right', 'w033-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w033-msg iw-msg';
  }
  inputs.forEach(i => i.addEventListener('input', clearMarks));
  root.querySelector('.w033-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, empty = 0;
    inputs.forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w033-right', 'w033-wrong');
      const raw = inp.value.trim().replace(',', '.').replace(/%$/, '').trim();
      if (!raw) { empty++; return; }
      const v = parseFloat(raw);
      const a = ANSWERS[Number(inp.dataset.k)];
      if (isFinite(v) && Math.abs(v - a.value) <= a.tol) { inp.classList.add('w033-right'); right++; }
      else { inp.classList.add('w033-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === ANSWERS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ Correct - every chained component spends availability.'; msg.className = 'w033-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + empty + ' field(s) still empty (multiply the availabilities first).'; msg.className = 'w033-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red value is off; the combined availability is the product of the three.'; msg.className = 'w033-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w033-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs.forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w033-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w033-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    inputs.forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = ANSWERS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].show;
      inp.classList.add('w033-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w033-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w033-expl').hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
